title: LM Fight Arena: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models via Game Competition
abstract: arXiv:2510.08928v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing benchmarks for large multimodal models (LMMs) often fail to capture their performance in real-time, adversarial environments. We introduce LM Fight Arena (Large Model Fight Arena), a novel framework that evaluates LMMs by pitting them against each other in the classic fighting game Mortal Kombat II, a task requiring rapid visual understanding and tactical, sequential decision-making. In a controlled tournament, we test six leading open- and closed-source models, where each agent operates controlling the same character to ensure a fair comparison. The models are prompted to interpret game frames and state data to select their next actions. Unlike static evaluations, LM Fight Arena provides a fully automated, reproducible, and objective assessment of an LMM's strategic reasoning capabilities in a dynamic setting. translated_title: LM Fight Arena：通过游戏竞技对大型多模态模型进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有的大型多模态模型（LMMs）基准测试往往无法捕捉其在实时对抗环境中的表现。我们提出了LM Fight Arena（大型模型格斗竞技场），这是一个新颖的评估框架，通过让大型多模态模型在经典格斗游戏《真人快打II》中相互对抗来评估它们，该任务需要快速的视觉理解和战术性、序列化的决策能力。在一项受控锦标赛中，我们测试了六个领先的开源和闭源模型，其中每个智能体控制相同的角色以确保公平比较。模型被要求解读游戏画面帧和状态数据来选择其下一步行动。与静态评估不同，LM Fight Arena 为大型多模态模型在动态环境中的战略推理能力提供了完全自动化、可复现且客观的评估。这项工作引入了一个具有挑战性且引人入胜的基准，弥合了人工智能评估与交互式环境之间的差距。
tldr: 该论文提出了LM Fight Arena框架，通过让大型多模态模型在格斗游戏《真人快打II》中实时对战，实现了对其动态对抗环境下视觉理解与战略推理能力的完全自动化、可复现的客观评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LM Fight Arena, a novel benchmark that evaluates large multimodal models by pitting them against each other in Mortal Kombat II, providing a fully automated, reproducible, and objective assessment of their strategic reasoning in dynamic, adversarial game environments.
